title: San Francisco addresses with the most separate Medicare group practices
question: At which San Francisco street addresses are many separately enrolled group practices registered?
finding: 64 San Francisco street addresses carry two or more separately enrolled Medicare group practices; the most is 2100 Webster St, San Francisco 94115 with 12 practices and 97 clinicians. The top addresses are hospital and medical-office campuses; nothing here resembles the single-apartment registrations of the San José case.
how: Doctors and Clinicians national file, San Francisco practice addresses; a practice is an organization enrolment number with its name; address is the street line without suite plus ZIP code.
limits: Hospitals, university clinics and medical office towers house many practices; this is a map of where medicine is practised, not a sign of anything wrong. Addresses with fewer than five clinicians (22 of them) are counted and not listed, because they may be homes: a clinician who reads scans remotely for many out-of-state groups shows up this way.
